blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Creamline kicked off its title defense with a 25-18, 25-21, 25-18 sweep of Akari in front of 19,106 fans in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series opener on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena here. Buoyed by the new record crowd in Cebu’s newest arena, the Cool Smashers asserted their dominance and depth, with Alas Pilipinas setter Jia De Guzman returning to orchestrate their offense. Jema Galanza led Creamline as it joined sister team Choco Mucho among the winners of the PVL’s 10th season opener. Creamline nearly let a commanding lead slip away in the second set, when […]...
